cells.text: SEC approved listing of a futures-based 3x Bitcoin ETF (one of six VS Trust 3x funds). — Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Volatility Shares LLC (sponsor of VS Trust) — Exchange listing rule change approved (Release No. 34-106577). The order does not address whether the funds' registration is effective or whether trading has begun.
